wording.hookAsk: Which part of King Arthur's legend {hook}?

role.pick: In the legend of King Arthur, what is {label}?
role.statement: In the legend of King Arthur, {label} is {value}.
role.match: Match each name from King Arthur's legend to who or what it is.
role.reverse: In the legend of King Arthur, which name is {value}?

rows.label: King Arthur
rows.role: the legendary king of Britain who gathered the knights
rows.description: legendary British leader of the late 5th and early 6th centuries
rows.hook: is the fabled monarch of medieval romance who sits with his champions around a circular table

rows.label: Merlin
rows.role: the wizard who advised the king and arranged his birth
rows.hook: is the legendary prophet and magician of medieval Britain, famed for shaping a famous court

rows.label: Morgan le Fay
rows.hook: is a powerful enchantress of Arthurian tales, often cast as a scheming rival to her own brother

rows.label: Lady of the Lake
rows.role: the mysterious woman who gave the king his sword
rows.description: ruler of Avalon in the Arthurian legend
rows.hook: is the enchantress of legend who hands a famous blade to a young hero from beneath the water

rows.label: Excalibur
rows.hook: is the legendary blade of Britain's mythic ruler, tied to a stone-pulling tale and a watery giver

rows.label: Uther Pendragon
rows.role: the king's father, a ruler of Britain
rows.description: father of King Arthur in Arthurian legend
rows.hook: is the fabled monarch who fathered a famous hero after Merlin disguised him as a rival

rows.label: Avalon
rows.role: the misty island where the king was taken to heal
rows.description: legendary island featured in the Arthurian legend
rows.hook: is the legendary isle where a wounded monarch was carried after his last battle

rows.label: Holy Grail
rows.role: the sacred cup the knights set out to find
rows.description: cup, dish or stone with miraculous powers, important motif in Arthurian literature
rows.hook: is the treasured vessel that Round Table champions spend years seeking in medieval romance

rows.label: Lancelot
rows.role: the greatest knight, whose love for the queen broke the kingdom
rows.hook: is the celebrated Round Table champion who had a secret affair with his monarch's wife

rows.label: Guinevere
rows.role: the king's queen, who loved his best knight
rows.hook: is the legendary wife of Britain's mythic monarch whose romance helped bring down his realm

rows.label: Mordred
rows.role: the traitor who rebelled against the king and gave him his last wound
rows.hook: is the treacherous knight who turned on his own uncle at the final battle of the legend

rows.label: Camelot
rows.description: mythical castle and court associated with King Arthur
rows.hook: is the fabled seat of a legendary British monarch, a symbol of chivalry with a Round Table

rows.label: Fisher King
rows.role: the wounded keeper of the sacred cup
rows.description: Keeper of the Holy Grail in Arthurian legend

rows.label: Galahad
rows.role: the pure knight, son of Lancelot, who achieved the sacred quest
rows.hook: is the spotless teenage Round Table champion who succeeds where all the others fail

rows.label: Gawain
rows.role: the king's nephew who accepted a beheading challenge
rows.hook: is the Round Table knight who faces a mysterious green challenger in a famous Middle English poem

rows.label: Glastonbury Tor
rows.role: the Somerset hill linked with the misty island
rows.hook: is the steep conical landmark crowned by a ruined church tower, tied by tradition to Avalon
